name: council-loop
description: Research-backed looped engineering: gate -> researchers and a codebase mapper -> 7-expert council with blind votes, red team and cross-lab elders (7->5->3->1) -> verified build loop -> lessons. A shared memory of sourced facts (project files or Obsidian). A resumable run loop (next / ingest) does the bookkeeping. Model picks per role from Artificial Analysis data.
